response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, staff-level generalist engineer with 15+ years across web, mobile, and infrastructure, and some exposure to MCP tooling and agentic frameworks in his current role, but he lacks the core requirement of 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions. There is no evidence of Python usage, RAG architectures, vector databases, or LLM evaluation/optimization work, making him a weak match for this GenAI-focused staff role.
strengths: Extensive staff/senior-level engineering experience (15+ years) across diverse stacks and industries
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic workflow tooling at re:cinq
Strong mentoring, teaching, and customer/community engagement track record (workshops, talks, open source)
concerns: No demonstrated Python experience, a required language for this role
No evidence of RAG architectures, vector databases, or AI-specific cloud platform design work
AI/GenAI experience is limited to ~1 year in current role, far short of the 8+ years required

key_factors.factor: Lack of 8+ years AI/GenAI solution-building experience
No Python and no RAG/vector database experience
Strong general staff-level engineering and mentoring background
